a.lede: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reportedly had an extramarital affair with a direct report, following a separate affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.
a.title: Jensen Huang now accused of affair with Nvidia executive who reported to him, alleged cover-up attempt

b.lede: Donald Trump defended defense secretary Pete Hegseth, who is facing an impeachment resolution from Republican senator Thomas Massie, saying Hegseth 'won two wars'. The president, who said he had spoken to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, said he was 'amazed' by claims Huang conducted an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, and that the FBI was now looking into the issue
b.title: Trump backs embattled Hegseth and Jensen Huang and says FBI looking into spy allegations – video
